raw_response:
I’m planting cotton on all 12 mu again. I’ve done this a long time, and cotton is what I know. I won’t do anything fancy. Last year when the stand was even and I fed it in two rounds, it held better, so this year I’ll do about the same. I’ll sow around mid to late April, use the cotton seed people around here are buying from the local dealer, put some fertilizer in before planting, then add a bit more when the plants start growing strong. Water costs money from the well, so I won’t flood too many times, but I also won’t let the field stay dry too long, especially at budding and boll setting. If insects show up, I’ll spray. If I spend too little, yield drops and that hurts more than spending a bit extra, but I still have to watch cash because we’re only a 2-person household and 12 mu is not a big farm.
